G1700.def: a prolonged form of «3449»; of me:--me, mine, my.

G1702.def: from «1722» and «3815»; to jeer at, i.e. deride:--mock.

G1703.def: from «1702»; a derider, i.e. (by implication) a false teacher:--mocker, scoffer.

G1704.def: from «1722» and «4043»; to perambulate on a place, i.e. (figuratively) to be occupied among persons:--walk in.

G1705.def: from «1722» and the base of «4118»;to fill in (up), i.e. (by implication) to satisfy (literally or figuratively):--fill.

G1706.def: from «1722» and «4098»; to fall on, i.e. (literally) to be entrapped by, or (figuratively) be overwhelmed with:--fall among (into).

G1707.def: from «1722» and «4120»; to entwine, i.e. (figuratively) involve with:--entangle (in, self with).

G1708.def: from «1707»; elaborate braiding of the hair:--plaiting.

G1709.def: from «1722» and «4154»; to inhale, i.e. (figuratively) to be animated by (bent upon):--breathe.

G1710.def: from «1722» and «4198»; to travel in (a country as a pedlar), i.e. (by implication) to trade:--buy and sell, make merchandise.

G1713.def: from «1722» and the base of «4198»; a (wholesale) tradesman:--merchant.

G1714.et: from (1722) and pretho (to blow a flame)
G1714.def: from «1722» and pretho (to blow a flame); to enkindle, i.e. set on fire:--burn up.

G1715.def: from «1722» and «4314»; in front of (in place (literally or figuratively) or time):--against, at, before, (in presence, sight) of.

G1716.def: from «1722» and «4429»; to spit at or on:--spit (upon).

G1717.def: from a compound of «1722» and «5316»; apparent in self:--manifest, openly.

G1718.def: from «1717»; to exhibit (in person) or disclose (by words):--appear, declare (plainly), inform, (will) manifest, shew, signify.

G1719.def: from «1722» and «5401»; in fear, i.e. alarmed:--affrighted, afraid, tremble.

G1720.def: from «1722» and phusao (to puff) (compare «5453»); to blow at or on:--breathe on.

G1721.def: from «1722» and a derivative of «5453»; implanted (figuratively):--engrafted.

G1722.et: a primary preposition denoting (fixed) position (in place, time or state), and (by implication) instrumentality (medially or constructively), i.e. a relation of rest (intermediate between (1519) and (1537))
G1722.def: a primary preposition denoting (fixed) position (in place, time or state), and (by implication) instrumentality (medially or constructively), i.e. a relation of rest (intermediate between «1519» and «1537»); "in," at, (up-)on, by, etc.:--about, after, against, + almost, × altogether, among, × as, at, before, between, (here-)by (+ all means), for (... sake of), + give self wholly to, (here-)in(-to, -wardly), × mightily, (because) of, (up-)on, (open-)ly, × outwardly, one, × quickly, × shortly, (speedi-)ly, × that, × there(-in, -on), through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), under, when, where(-with), while, with(-in). Often used in compounds, with substantially the same import; rarely with verbs of motio

G1723.def: from «1722» and a derivative of «43»; to take in one's arms, i.e. embrace:--take up in arms.

G1724.def: from «1722» and «251»; in the sea, i.e. marine:--thing in the sea.

G1725.def: from «1722» and «473»; in front (i.e. figuratively, presence) of:--before.

G1726.def: neuter of «1727»; (adverbially) in the presence (view) of:--before, in the presence of.

G1727.def: from «1725»; opposite; figuratively, antagonistic:--(over) against, contrary.

G1728.def: from «1722» and «756»; to commence on:--rule (by mistake for «757»).

G1729.et: from a compound of (1722) and (1210) (in the sense of lacking)
G1729.def: from a compound of «1722» and «1210» (in the sense of lacking); deficient in:--lacking.

G1731.def: from «1722» and «1166»; to indicate (by word or act):--do, show (forth).

G1733.def: from (the neuter of) «1520» and «1176»; one and ten, i.e. eleven:--eleven.

G1735.et: third person singular present of a compound of (1722) and (1209)
G1735.def: third person singular present of a compound of «1722» and «1209»; (impersonally) it is accepted in, i.e. admitted (possible):--can (+ not) be.

G1736.def: from a compound of «1722» and «1218»; to be in one's own country, i.e. home (figuratively):--be at home (present).

G1737.def: a prolonged form of «1746»; to invest (with a garment):--clothe in, wear.

G1738.def: from «1722» and «1349»; in the right, i.e. equitable:--just.

G1739.et: from a compound of (1722) and a derivative of the base of (1218)
G1739.def: from a compound of «1722» and a derivative of the base of «1218»; a housing in (residence), i.e. structure:--building.

G1741.def: from «1722» and «1391»; in glory, i.e. splendid, (figuratively) noble:--glorious, gorgeous(-ly), honourable.

G1742.def: from «1746»; apparel (especially the outer robe):--clothing, garment, raiment.

G1743.def: from «1722» and «1412»; to empower:--enable, (increase in) strength(-en), be (make) strong.

G1744.def: from «1772» and «1416»; to sink (by implication, wrap (compare «1746») on, i.e. (figuratively) sneak:--creep.

G1746.et: from (1722) and (1416) (in the sense of sinking into a garment)
G1746.def: from «1722» and «1416» (in the sense of sinking into a garment); to invest with clothing (literally or figuratively):--array, clothe (with), endue, have (put) on.

G1747.def: feminine from «1722» and the base of «1476»; an ambuscade, i.e. (figuratively) murderous purpose:--lay wait. See also «1749».

G1748.def: from «1747»; to lurk, i.e. (figuratively) plot assassination:--lay wait for.

G1749.def: neuter of the same as «1747»; an ambush, i.e. (figuratively) murderous design:--lying in wait.

G1750.def: from «1772» and the base of «1507»; to enwrap:--wrap in.

G1751.def: from «1772» and «1510»; to be within (neuter participle plural):--such things as ... have. See also «1762».

G1752.def: of uncertain affinity; on account of:--because, for (cause, sake), (where-)fore, by reason of, that.

G1754.def: from «1756»; to be active, efficient:--do, (be) effectual (fervent), be mighty in, shew forth self, work (effectually in).

G1757.def: from «1722» and «2127»; to confer a benefit on:--bless.

G1758.def: from «1722» and «2192»; to hold in or upon, i.e. ensnare; by implication, to keep a grudge:--entangle with, have a quarrel against, urge.

G1759.def: from a prolonged form of «1722»; properly, within, i.e. (of place) here, hither:--(t-)here, hither.

G1760.def: from a compound of «1722» and «2372»; to be inspirited, i.e. ponder:--think.

G1762.et: contraction for the third person singular present indicative of (1751)
G1762.def: contraction for the third person singular present indicative of «1751»; impersonally, there is in or among:--be, (there) is.

G1763.et: prolongation from a primary enos (a year)
G1763.def: prolongation from a primary enos (a year); a year:--year.

G1764.def: from «1722» and «2476»; to place on hand, i.e. (reflexively) impend, (participle) be instant:--come, be at hand, present.

G1765.def: from «1722» and «2480»; to invigorate (transitively or reflexively):--strengthen.

G1768.et: from a (tenth) multiple of (1767)">1767) and 1767 itself
G1768.def: from a (tenth) multiple of «1767» and «1767» itself; ninety-nine:--ninety and nine.

G1769.def: from «1770»; dumb (as making signs), i.e. silent from astonishment:--speechless.

G1770.def: from «1722» and «3506»; to nod at, i.e. beckon or communicate by gesture:--make signs.

G1771.def: from a compound of «1722» and «3563»; thoughtfulness, i.e. moral understanding:--intent, mind.

G1772.def: from «1722» and «3551»; (subjectively) legal, or (objectively) subject to:--lawful, under law.

G1773.et: neuter of a compound of (1722) and (3571)
G1773.def: neuter of a compound of «1722» and «3571»; (adverbially) by night:--before day.

G1776.def: from «1722» and «3791»; to crowd in, i.e. (figuratively) to annoy:--trouble.

G1777.def: from «1758»; liable to (a condition, penalty or imputation):--in danger of, guilty of, subject to.

G1778.def: from «1781»; an injunction, i.e. religious precept:--commandment.

G1779.def: from a compound of «1722» and «5028»; to inswathe with cerements for interment:--bury.

G1781.def: from «1722» and the base of «5056»; to enjoin:--(give) charge, (give) command(-ments), injoin.

G1782.def: from the same as «1759»; hence (literally or figuratively); (repeated) on both sides:--(from) hence, on either side.

G1783.def: from «1793»; an interview, i.e. (specially) supplication:--intercession, prayer.

G1784.def: from «1722» and «5092»; valued (figuratively):--dear, more honourable, precious, in reputation.

G1785.def: from «1781»; injunction, i.e. an authoritative prescription:--commandment, precept.

G1786.def: from «1722» and «5117»; a resident:--of that place.

G1788.def: from «1722» and the base of «5157»; to invert, i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) in a good sense, to respect; or in a bad one, to confound:--regard, (give) reference, shame.

G1789.def: from «1722» and «5142»; (figuratively) to educate:--nourish up in.

G1792.def: from «1722» and «5171»; to revel in:--sporting selves.

G1793.def: from «1722» and «5177»; to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) confer with; by extension to entreat (in favor or against):--deal with, make intercession.

G1794.et: from (1722) and tulisso (to twist, probably akin to (1507))
G1794.def: from «1722» and tulisso (to twist; probably akin to «1507»); to entwine, i.e. wind up in:--wrap in (together).

G1795.def: from «1722» and a derivative of «5179»; to enstamp, i.e. engrave:--engrave.

G1796.def: from «1722» and «5195»; to insult:--do despite unto.

G1798.def: from «1722» and «5258»; something seen in sleep, i.e. a dream (vision in a dream):--dream.

G1799.et: neuter of a compound of (1722) and a derivative of (3700)
G1799.def: neuter of a compound of «1722» and a derivative of «3700»; in the face of (literally or figuratively):--before, in the presence (sight) of, to.
